description: Header file defining an extension of icLinkedList to support sorted insertion, including type definitions, function prototypes for creating and adding to a sorted linked list, and licensing information.

methods.name: sortedLinkedListCreate
methods.description: Creates a new sorted linked list with a specified comparison function.

methods.name: sortedLinkedListAdd
methods.description: Adds an item to the sorted linked list in the correct position based on the comparison function.
